title: Blocking waits without timeout can deadlock UI and automation
description: Flags blocking wait calls that do not set a finite timeout. Wait-Process without -Timeout and .WaitForExit() without an argument can hang indefinitely when child processes stall, causing frozen UI paths and stuck pipeline stages. Related sync-over-async blocking hazards — chaining .Result / .GetResult() onto a *Async() Task (P079) and accepting WebSocket upgrades via AcceptWebSocketAsync inside the single-threaded engine (P080) — pin threads the same way and were the verified 8042 engine HANG.
detection_method: Regex scan for Wait-Process calls missing -Timeout and Process.WaitForExit() calls without timeout argument
preventionRule: All blocking waits must use explicit timeout values and fallback behavior when the timeout is reached.
